card.name: Words leading into a patient condition
card.fires_on: Words that sit between a patient group and the disease or condition that defines it, such as 'with' after 'patients', or 'active' or 'advanced' before a disease name. It appears in trial and indication sentences.

modes.label: 'with' after patient group
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'patients' or an age group, introducing a condition or risk factor.
modes.example: In adjunctive clinical trials in adult patients<< with>> partial-onset seizures

modes.label: Disease qualifier
modes.description: An adjective such as active or advanced placed before a disease name.
modes.example: moderately to severely<< active>> CD is 5 mg/kg given as

modes.label: Inside trial or disease terms
modes.description: Partway through a word or phrase that describes a trial population or disease.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or adjective just before the name of the disease a group of patients has.
